Can we use consistency?  Sometimes you're using "Cable_Present" and sometimes you're using "CBL_PRSNT".

Since you've used the name as "CBL_PRSNT" and in the resulting cable config you used "$NAME" doesn't that mean we end up with a cable named "XYZ Cable Present"?  Shouldn't the name be the name of the cable without the "Present"?
